Meet the Eng team

Driving innovation at scale

About the Role

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you are the Global Technical Anchor for systems powering every Uber trip and transaction. You define the multi-year vision for the backend ecosystem, acting as a peer to Directors and VPs to ground Uber’s most ambitious business goals in technical reality.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Strategy: Define the "North Star" multi-year roadmap and lead high-stakes "buy vs. build" evaluations on the Architecture Review Board.
  • Execution & Excellence: Directly tackle high-risk challenges, driving a company-wide shift toward "Zero-Trust" and "Always-On" architectures.
  • Mentorship & Influence: Act as a "leader of leaders" by mentoring Staff Engineers and serving as a strategic advisor to VP/CTO level leadership.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience: 12+ years of experience delivering massive-scale distributed systems.
  • Technical Depth: Expert-level understanding of distributed theory (CAP theorem, Paxos/Raft) and technical transformations.
  • Education: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or equivalent industry experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Open Source: Significant contributions to major open-source infrastructure or distributed systems projects.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep vertical expertise in FinTech or Security at a global "Big Tech" scale.
  • Architectural Migration: Experience migrating monolithic architectures to modular or cell-based paradigms.

Why Uber?

Here, your work helps move the real world — through streets, stores, airports, hospitals, homes, businesses, and cities across 70+ countries. We build technology that helps people go where they need to go, get what they need, earn on their terms, and keep cities moving.

The problems are complex, the pace is fast, and the impact is visible. Whether you’re building from 0 to 1, improving systems at massive scale, or experimenting with new technology, you’ll help support 40 million trips a day while working with people who raise the bar and support you as you grow.
